mechanism_narrative: Because WORKPLACES and TRANSIT are still far below baseline but rose in the latest week, a continued return-to-commuting flow should lift retail visits over the next four weeks as weekday footfall rebuilds from commuting spillovers.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -35.3 to -25.4 and TRANSIT improved from -50.4 to -43.6 in the latest week
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue improving yet RETAIL_REC stays below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days, the commuting-spillover mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, people spend more time near home and substitute local shopping and errand trips for long-distance travel, which should push RETAIL_REC upward within one to two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive in every week while GROCERY_PHARM remained less negative than RETAIL_REC
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline but RETAIL_REC does not rise within 14 days relative to the prior two weeks, the local-neighborhood substitution hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp recovery in PARKS after a depressed week indicates relaxation in outing constraints and broader willingness to leave home; that spillover should increase retail and recreation visits over the following month.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 15 points week-on-week after a prior weekly decline
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from 17.3 to 20.9 after dropping from 43.0
failure_condition: If PARKS crosses the stated rebound threshold and RETAIL_REC does not improve over the next 28 days, the outing-relaxation signal is false.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains deeply depressed while WORKPLACES also stay weak, access friction and suppressed commuting keep discretionary trips constrained, causing RETAIL_REC to fall or stay flat over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed below -40 and WORKPLACES stayed below -25 in all four weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain at roughly current depressed levels but RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean, the access-friction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week improvement in GROCERY_PHARM usually reflects rising essential-trip confidence before discretionary spending recovers; that lead indicator should precede a modest RETAIL_REC increase within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM improves by at least 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -22.6 to -17.1 in the latest week
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM improves by at least 5 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days, the lead-indicator claim fails.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of strong PARKS usage and weak TRANSIT signals weather- or leisure-driven substitution toward outdoor activity; when this pattern persists, retail visitation typically softens over the next four weeks as trips are displaced from shopping districts.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS has remained positive while TRANSIT remains around -45 to -51
failure_condition: If PARKS stays above baseline and TRANSIT stays heavily negative but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, the leisure-substitution mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES from very negative levels signals easing operational restrictions and more routine daytime movement, which should lift retail and recreation spending with about a four-week lag.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -30 after being below -30 in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -35.3 to -25.4 in the latest week
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES crosses above -30 and RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-4-week mean within 28 days, the reopening-lag hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT while RESIDENTIAL falls indicates more people are back in external activity spaces rather than staying home, and that joint shift should raise RETAIL_REC over the next one to two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose, TRANSIT rose, and RESIDENTIAL fell in the latest week
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT rise while RESIDENTIAL falls but RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 to 14 days, the mobility-composition mechanism fails.
